The '''Hunter Knife''' is an {{Uncommon}} [[Sword]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Hunter Knife''' is received after the player speaks to {{NPCSprite|Gustave}} after finishing the [[Woods Race]] in {{Green|1 minute}} or less. Afterwards, it can be purchased from {{NPCSprite|Rusty}} for {{Coins|500,000}}.

== Usage ==

=== Minion Upgrade ===
{{Affected Minions List|upgrade|Potato|table_header=a {{Item|Potato Minion}}|table_list=n}} It makes the minion produce {{Item|French Fries}}.

== Tips ==
*It's good for early-game grinding, such as slaying Miner Zombies for {{LI|Miner Armor}} as it gives a {{stat|spd}} boost.
*Although this weapon is not very effective for damage, the {{stat|spd|+40}} could be quite useful early-game before using {{Item|God Potion}}, especially when combined with the {{Item|Rogue Sword}}.

== Trivia ==
* It is the only weapon obtained from a [[Races|Race]].
